chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abdillah عليه السلام: A man performed the fajr prayer when dawn had risen? He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: dawn; the beginning time associated here with salat al-fajr
key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man; the subject of the legal question
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat al-fajr when dawn has risen?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling about the time of salat al-fajr. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem with performing the fajr prayer when dawn has risen, indicating permissibility at that time.
